resources.string: You can take this tour again from the menu, under Dahlia.
The compass opens the play field. Drag a finger across it and the mandala changes as you go.
The star holds the mandalas you keep, and a few are already there. Tap one to open it, or add the one you see.
The arrow saves your picture or sets it as wallpaper. Share is in the menu behind the three dots.
Every layer has a style, like %1$s or %2$s. Open this row and tap one, and the picture changes right away.
A palette colours the layer. Open this row to try another one or to make your own.
Scene adds light, grain, stars and more. Switch the effects on here, then hold the picture to see it without them.
Wherever you see this die, it rolls something new at random, and more dots change more. The arrow at the top left takes you back.
